definitions.gloss: rejuvenation; looking or feeling younger; renewal
definitions.explanation: The process of becoming or looking younger, or of being refreshed and renewed. Used for both physical appearance and for organizations or systems being revitalized.

examples.japanese: {若返|わかがえ}りの{秘訣|ひけつ}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me the secret to rejuvenation.

examples.japanese: この{化粧品|けしょうひん}は{肌|はだ}の{若返|わかがえ}りに{効果|こうか}がある。
examples.english: This cosmetic product is effective for skin rejuvenation.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいメンバーが{加|くわ}わり、チームの{若返|わかがえ}りが{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: With the addition of new members, the team is undergoing rejuvenation.

notes: Derived from the verb {若返|わかがえ}る (to become younger, to be rejuvenated). Used in beauty and health contexts: {若返|わかがえ}りの{効果|こうか} (rejuvenating effect), アンチエイジング / {若返|わかがえ}り{治療|ちりょう} (anti-aging treatment). Also used metaphorically for organizations: {組織|そしき}の{若返|わかがえ}り (organizational rejuvenation, bringing in younger members), {世代交代|せだいこうたい}と{若返|わかがえ}り (generational change and renewal).
